notes: Three ἔνοχος ἔσται clauses analysed alike under rule 24: in danger on the adjective, shall be on the expressed copula.
εἰς takes of at t047 because a Greek preposition is expressed, leaving the article a bare the under rule 19.
πᾶς ὁ ὀργιζόμενος split under rule 80's second arm: every on the quantifier, one on the article, who is angry on the participle.
The anarthrous vocative Μωρέ takes the supplied Thou as a rule 7 helper under rule 89's closing clause.
